name: fix-objectives-vault-art
about: Issue #26, mods/objectives: a vault is drawn as the floor's own room, and its levers stay off the map unless the Architect's Marked Switches is picked. The vault's cells were ReserveFloor/ReserveWall, which stay consumed through the brush's build, so it painted no walls and none of the floor's spots or trim there. Now PlaceFloor/PlaceWall, freed before the painting and the floor cells taken back after it. On a keep floor (keep_1) and a temple floor (crypt index 0, temple_1): the painted line counts every vault floor cell as Floor and all 28 ring cells as free Wall, `hwp objectives` says neither lever is on the map, and shots from the door, inside, and inside unlit. Then with `hwp architect try hwp_objectives_marked_switches` a keep floor puts both levers on the map. Mods core + architect + objectives.
